construction.source_lemma:
Complete marked slabs and the common-phase interval selection lemma
==================================================================

Let A_0,A_1 be the two actual fixed-frame AP4 bodies from the balanced
source, with full vertical projection [-H/2,H/2]. Let a=(d,0), b=(x,h)
be its planar basis. The reviewed source proves that, for each sigma in
{0,1}, all bodies

  A_(i+j+sigma mod 2) + (i*a+j*b,0),  (i,j) in Z^2,

have disjoint interiors. Both choices are covered by the ordered source
checks from both initial types, not by an unsupported relabeling.
The exact AP4 parameters are d=(1+sqrt(2))/2,
x=(-2+3sqrt(2))/4, h=(6-sqrt(2))/4. Source and independent review hashes
are bound by SOURCE_LEMMA_MANIFEST.json.

1. Whole-slab extension.
For every integer l choose any horizontal translation -m_l and a symbol
sigma_l. At common vertical phase delta place every body of this slab at

  c_(i,j,l)=(i*a+j*b-m_l, delta+lH).

Two bodies in one slab are disjoint by translation of the planar source.
Bodies in different slabs have disjoint open vertical projection
intervals, so their interiors are disjoint, independently of all m_l
and sigma_l. Their closed boundaries may meet. Any finite subset is
therefore a valid packing in unbounded space. Neither equal contact
rings nor a global parity law i+j+l is required. Actual frames remain
those of the chosen A_t throughout.

2. Exact host intervals at a prescribed scale.
Let K(s)={p: w_f.p <= s beta_f for every f} be the one fixed bounded
convex host; beta_f>0. For a marked planar owner with center c_xy and
type t define q_f=s beta_f-w_f,xy.c_xy-h_(A_t)(w_f).
Containment at absolute height z is equivalent to every inequality
w_f,z z <= q_f. If w_f,z=0 and q_f<0 this owner is impossible. Otherwise
the inequalities with negative vertical coefficient give lower bounds
z>=q_f/w_f,z, and positive ones give upper bounds z<=q_f/w_f,z.
The owner is admissible exactly on their closed intersection [L,U],
which is empty if L>U. Keep every attaining wall and all its actual
supporting owner vertices. At slab l its admissible phase interval is
[L-lH,U-lH] intersected with [0,H].

3. Finite family completeness and selection.
Fix a finite set of marked planar alternatives v=(m,sigma). Since the
host is bounded and a,b are independent, only finitely many words
(i,j,l,v) can have a nonempty interval. In the AP4 application all owner
centroids are their declared centers. Containment implies the center
lies in K(s), hence |c_x|,|c_y|<=sR. Thus

  |j|h <= sR+max_v |m_v,y|,
  |i|d <= sR+max_v |m_v,x|+|j|x.

The host's top and bottom faces also give |z|<=(s-1)H/2, since each
owner has full height H. With delta in [0,H], all possible l satisfy
-(s+1)/2 <= l <= (s-1)/2. Conservative integer bounds proved against
these inequalities therefore cover every potentially admissible word.

For a fixed delta, let C_(l,v)(delta) count the whole owners in slab l
whose intervals contain delta for alternative v. Once delta is fixed,
there is no cross-slab compatibility condition beyond the common full
height spacing. Therefore the exact maximum number of whole source
owners in the host within this declared family is

  max_(delta in [0,H]) sum_l max_v C_(l,v)(delta).

For each l choose a maximizing v and retain all its admissible owners.
This gives a complete packing realizing the sum, not just marginal
counts. Conversely any allowed packing has at most that many in each
slab, proving equality. Equal-count alternatives remain distinct
factored choices; their geometries are not identified.

4. Complete event partition and period.
Let E consist of 0,H and every endpoint of every nonempty interval.
Membership is constant on each open component of [0,H]\E. Its exact
value at every event must also be evaluated, since intervals are closed.
Thus the finite event values plus one sample in every open component
give the exact maximum above and a full word/mark/frame decoder for it.
All endpoint ordering and membership comparisons use exact ordered
field arithmetic. No independent phase optimization by slab is valid.
Shifting delta by H reindexes every l to l+1 together with its entire
marked alternative, leaving the physical family unchanged. Hence one
period covers all phases; keeping both endpoints is harmless duplicate
coverage, not a new family.

Scope. The whole-slab extension permits arbitrary translations. The
finite capacity algorithm covers only the declared finite mark set at
the prescribed scale. The present pilot uses owner-center, ring-center,
axial-contact and row-contact horizontal marks with both symbols. The
first two share a horizontal geometry but retain distinct source marks.
The lemma does not prove a capacity for arbitrary horizontal phases,
other planar sources, overlapping-height layers, arbitrary frames, or
all packings. Later full-owner returns can leave this source family;
their complete common pair rows and host walls require separate proof.


Whole-slab quarter-turn interface return
=======================================

Let R=Rz(pi/2). For canonical AP4, R permutes each complete owner vertex
set separately and also permutes the exact self-host walls, with their
offsets unchanged. It fixes z. Thus applying R to all centers in any
one full-height slab, while retaining canonical owner frames through
their actual vertex permutations, preserves that slab's complete pair
packing and every host containment bound. Its source capacity at every
height is identical; there is no new capacity scan.

Starting from the four strongest previously retained envelope sources
at N41,42,48,100, rotate odd-indexed slabs and leave even ones fixed.
This is one discrete two-slab orientation word, not independently tuned
angles. Full H spacing keeps every cross-slab pair separated. All source
words, marks, symbols, whole owners and parent deletions are retained.

The changed relative in-plane positions give different actual cross-
slab contacts when the full-height constraint is released. Rebuild one
valid complete-palette separator for EVERY pair in the transformed
source, then solve all of those pair rows and all exact host walls in
one common full-owner return. Any subsequent contact change must be
valid at the preceding complete endpoint. No direct fixed-frame affine
path from the unrotated source is asserted. The new source itself is
proved by the explicit rigid slab maps and exact vertex permutations.

Keep the unrotated sources as equal-value initial boundary controls.
An endpoint improvement is promoted only after complete native source,
parent, path and final geometry checks plus current comparison.

The two tied least-cost cap owners from APPEND_PROPOSAL are distinct complete members of the same proved planar source at the same slab mark and symbol. Retain all48 source owners; append the second alone, then both together as separate complete controls. The common source law proves their mutual and old-new pair compatibility. Subsequent returns must retain all full pair rows and one host. No symmetry identifying the two49-owner completions is assumed.

contribution.method:
This batch contains 31 fresh campaign cases, distinct from our earlier submissions: 10 improvements beyond the pinned current nominal/reference bounds and 21 improved complete certificates from physical source operations. Twenty certificate cases retain explicitly known nominal values; PR12L1.5/cube N24 conservatively claims only a reduced complete certificate. No new ideal bound is claimed for those 21 cases.

The constructions use marked cap exchanges and common separator returns, whole-child collar and height transfers, cross-base whole-prism inclusion and axial subdivision, complete prism self-host enclosure, and marked Catalan returns. Complete source owners, inherited author credits, frames, all host walls, pair separators, and the relevant common restoration paths are retained. The 75-dodecagonal-prism construction, for example, comes from 25 complete octagonal source prisms through a certified whole-envelope inclusion and three-child axial partition; its certified cube side is 10.834711256138021, below the retained bound of 11. Fixed-contact stress certificates and local frame results retain their stated scope; no global optimum is claimed.
